dedupe_keys.name: fahrraddiebstahl in berlin daily police data on bicycle thefts

description: Berlin's police publish daily data on bicycle theft offences, drawn from the police trend statistics in their management information data warehouse, on the Berlin open data portal. Coverage: the State of Berlin at the level of the city's LOR planning areas, with all offences of the current year up to the day before the update and the whole previous year, where the time of the offence can be narrowed to at most three days. Columns read in the file header on 29 September 2026 give the date recorded, the start and end date and hour of the offence, the planning area code, the damage amount, whether it was an attempt, the type of bicycle, the offence and the recording reason. Format and access: a CSV file refreshed daily by the police, with a PDF dataset description. Licence and cost: free under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: only two years are kept at any time, so a long record needs regular copies, and locations are planning areas, not points. The counts can be used to weight theft risk at stations and bike parking in route choice or parking siting models. It relates to the Toronto police bicycle theft data and BikeMaps.org in the catalogue.
